exposure: Women with different number of cesarean deliveries
finding: Cesarean delivery, regardless of birth order, was associated with a lower likelihood of future birth, decreasing in a dose-response fashion as the number of cesarean deliveries increased, although this relationship was attenuated among low-income women.
